alt: Diagram of the PS5 menu paths that turn on Auto-Install in Rest Mode and Stay Connected to the Internet.

data.title: Turn on automatic updates (PS5)
data.body: Settings > Saved Data and Game/App Settings > Automatic Updates > Auto-Install in Rest Mode. Then Settings > System > Power Saving > Features Available in Rest Mode > Stay Connected to the Internet.
data.tip: Official PlayStation steps. Xbox path: check on your console.
